selection_process: Subject Number of Questions
English Comprehension 10
Hindi Comprehension 10
Food and Nutrition 10
Quantitative Aptitude 5
Hygiene and Cleanliness 5
Total 40 questions, 1 mark each
Subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria
applications will be scrutinized and suitable candidates shortlisted for further selection
comprising Scrutiny/Shortlisting
a Written Examination
and a Skill Test. Candidates may also be required to undergo a proficiency/practical test if further required.
280 candidates (40 eligible applications against each vacancy) will be shortlisted out of all eligible applications received
based on the percentage of total marks obtained in Matriculation (10th Standard) or the equivalent exam
for the next round - the objective-type written examination.
In case of a tie based on percentage of marks

the following criteria will be applied in sequence: (1) the candidate older in age as on the last date of receipt of application will be placed higher in merit; (2) if candidates have equal marks/percentage and the same date of birth
all such candidates will be allowed to appear in the written examination
irrespective of the prescribed shortlisting limit.
The written examination is of 30 minutes' duration (40 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe assistance). One mark is awarded for each correct answer

and one-fourth (0.25) mark is deducted for each incorrect answer. The standard of questions is of matriculation level. Question papers will be set in Hindi and English only; in case of any discrepancy between the two versions
the English version will prevail. There is no provision for re-evaluation or rechecking of scores
and the written examination will be held only in Bhopal

M.P. - no request for change of venue will be entertained. No Travelling Allowance is paid to shortlisted candidates for attending the written examination. Success in the written examination confers no automatic right to appointment.
Older candidate in age as on the last date of application Candidate with more marks secured in Food and Nutrition Candidate with more marks secured in Hygiene and Cleanliness
70 candidates (10 eligible candidates against each vacancy) will be shortlisted for the Skill Test
which will be conducted at Bhopal (M.P.) only. The Skill Test carries a total of 60 marks and evaluates the candidate's proficiency in duties commensurate with the post of Canteen Attendant
including preparation of beverages
basic food handling skills
preparation techniques
presentation
hygiene
and cleanliness.
The final merit list will be prepared based on the combined performance of candidates in the written examination and skill test (score out of 100)
and 07 candidates will be selected strictly on merit against the available category-wise vacancies. The final result will be displayed on the Notice Board of the Income Tax Department
O/o the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax
MP&CG
Aayakar Bhavan
Arera Hills
Bhopal 462011
and on the regional website https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in.
Document Verification (DV) will be conducted after declaration of the final result. Candidates must produce the relevant original certificates mentioned/submitted in the online application form
failing which their candidature will be cancelled. A waiting list will be maintained
and the next eligible candidate(s) in order of merit will be considered for appointment if a selected candidate fails to join
declines the offer
or is found ineligible at any stage.

Scribe assistance is provided to PwD candidates in pursuance of the relevant OMs issued by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. For persons with benchmark disabilities (PwBD) in the category of blindness or locomotor disability (both arms affected)
scribe facility is provided if desired
along with 10 minutes of compensatory time. Scribe facility is also available to PwD candidates with disability less than 40% who have difficulty in writing

on production of a certificate from a Chief Medical Officer/Civil Surgeon/Medical Superintendent of a Government healthcare institution. This facility must be opted for and indicated in the online application form; requests made later will not be entertained. Eligible candidates who do not avail of a scribe are also given 10 minutes of compensatory time
on production of the prescribed certificate.
Selected candidates shall be subjected to Medical Fitness
Verification of Character Antecedents/Police Verification. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere under the jurisdiction of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax
Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh.
how_to_apply: All candidates who wish to apply must fill the online application form available on the regional website of the department: https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in.
Go through the notification, Annexure-I, instructions to candidates, and vacancy positions carefully before filling up the application form.
Fill the online application form completely and correctly.
Upload a proper photograph (as per the specified format), scanned signature, valid photo ID, and relevant certificates/documents.

Submit the application online on or before 31-08-2026 (23:00 hrs). One candidate should apply only once - multiple applications by the same candidate will result in summary rejection of all such applications.

Applications received in any form other than online mode - including Post, Fax, Email, or by hand - will not be entertained by the Department. Eligible candidates will be called for the tests/verification, and the date and venue will be intimated to them in due course by the authorized officer.
important_instructions: Candidates already employed in the Central Government, State Government or a PSU should submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer, and the same should be mentioned in the application. Any form of canvassing by a candidate will render their candidature liable to be summarily rejected at any stage of the recruitment process. The Pr. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, MP&CG, has the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason, and to accept or reject the candidature of any applicant. In the event of any tie (other than those specifically addressed above), the decision of the Pr. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax MP&CG (CCA) shall be final. The Department reserves the right to change the last date for submission of application, publishing of shortlisted candidates for written examination, date of written examination/skill test, or publication of final result, if required. Candidates' admission at all stages of the examination is purely provisional, subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions. If, on verification at any time before or after the written examination, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any eligibility condition, their candidature will be cancelled. The crucial date for claiming SC/ST/OBC/PwBD status or any other benefit (reservation, age relaxation, etc.), where not specified otherwise, is the closing date for receipt of online applications, i.e., 31-08-2026. A person seeking appointment on the basis of OBC reservation must ensure they do not fall in the creamy layer on the cut-off date. A person seeking appointment on the basis of EWS reservation must possess an Income & Asset certificate valid for the financial year 2026-2027, issued on the basis of income for financial year 2025-26, in accordance with DoP&T OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31-01-2019. Candidates are cautioned that they will be debarred from the examination if they fraudulently claim SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM status or avail any other benefit. Candidature will remain provisional till the veracity of relevant documents is verified. Action against misconduct: If any candidate is found to indulge in malpractice at any stage of the recruitment process or thereafter, their candidature shall be cancelled. The Department may report the matter to Police/Investigating Agencies and take appropriate action, including examination by forensic experts. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be subject to Bhopal jurisdiction, and the decision of the Department on all related matters will be final and binding. For any difficulty in filling the online application form, or for correspondence/queries relating to the recruitment process, candidates may contact through the official e-mail ID: [email protected]. Any communication issued through this e-mail ID shall be treated as official communication for all purposes. Any corrigendum issued on this recruitment notification will be published only on the Department's website. Candidates are advised to visit https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in from time to time for updates and information.

content_sections.heading: ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 07 vacancies are available for the post of Canteen Attendant. The 07 vacancies include 1 Ex-Servicemen (ESM) vacancy and 1 Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) vacancy under Horizontal reservation. Candidates with 40% or more disability in the Orthopedically Handicapped (OH) category are eligible to be recruited under the PwBD category. The probation period for this post is 2 years.

Candidates possessing an equivalent educational qualification must produce the relevant Equivalence Certificate at the time of Document Verification. Candidates with a higher qualification may also apply.
